highestPriorityFindings.summary: The agent schema cannot represent required assignment and handoff fields.
The feature schema cannot represent OBSERVING, ROLLED_BACK, or failed-gate history.
No approval-record contract or gate ledger exists.
Operating-system schemas, skills, links, manifests, and scope are not validated in CI.
Main has no branch protection or rulesets, so required checks/gates are bypassable.
Future public-object defaults remain broad for postgres and supabase_admin and require platform-owner authority.
The current-state checkpoint was not reconciled after PR #1 and #2 merged.
The build graph has one fixable moderate PostCSS advisory; production-only dependencies are clean.

knownBlocker.reason: The available migration connection cannot change supabase_admin defaults, and built-in PUBLIC EXECUTE needs a global role-level change.
knownBlocker.stopCondition: Do not create another public object before resolution or an explicit bounded Security Gate exception.
